newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Resources Devt sees impact from quarry closure.
newsitem.headline: Resources Devt sees impact from quarry closure.

text.p: Building supplies company Resources Development Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it expected the impending closure of a quarry to hurt its performance for the full year ending December 31, 1997.

"The expected decrease in contributions arising from the impending closure of our Pulau Ubin quarry is expected to affect adversely the performance of the Group for the year," it said in a statement accompanying its six-months results.
For the first half ended June 30, 1997, Resources reported net profit leapt 38 percent to Singapore $9.5 million.
The company said it would recognise sales from two residential housing projects named Beechwood and Pinewood in the second half.
Of a total of 16 units of terrace houses, eight had been sold after the launch of the projects in the second quarter.
The company said it expected two residential projects to be launched during the second half.
